cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says a public digital-skills programme is in service and counted: the World Bank counted 226 people given improved digital skills under the Djibouti Digital Foundations Project by August 2024, but its coding academy and other digital-skills activities had not started.
cells.note: E-SKILLS and the Digital Foundations Project's skills activities are being prepared, so stage 2. The 226 counted are a project-wide capacity-building figure, not a public programme in service, so not stage 3.
